verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect data control. You can self-host the same software as Zulip Cloud, which puts the data on your own servers, and the export tools let you move data out, including consent-gated private messages. Nothing in the pack documents retention policies, message or account deletion, or automatic expiry. Missing for 10: documented message retention policies, user- or admin-initiated message and data deletion, automatic expiry or purge controls, any API for retention or deletion, independent corroboration.
